name.description: Name for the cluster. Max 63 characters, lowercase letters only, not a reserved name, and unique across Phase Two. Forms the default hostname `<name>.global.auth.ac`.

region.description: Region to provision the cluster in. Must be one of the values returned by `cluster.region.list`.

domain.description: Custom domain to associate with the cluster at creation. Must be a valid domain name.

price_id.description: Deprecated. Explicit Stripe price ID. When set, `tier` and `billing_period` are not required.

tier.description: Subscription tier, which determines the cluster's resource limits. Required unless `price_id` is set.

billing_period.description: Billing period. Required unless `price_id` is set. Starter is only available monthly.

org_id.description: ID of the organization that will own and be billed for the cluster.

payment_method_id.description: ID of an existing payment method on the organization's Stripe customer to charge immediately. When omitted, the response instead returns a Stripe Checkout link.
